title: THE DESIGN BRIEF
note: Figures and quotes are from UAF News (October 5th, 2026) and the NSF award record 2614749. The vessel, the barge and the ash are illustrations. Everything described is planned work.

lines.text: Picture a bioreactor that doesn't exist yet, already nervous about the power bill.
lines.t: Picture a bioreactor that doesn't exist yet, already nervous about the power bill.

lines.text: On October fifth, the University of Alaska Fairbanks announced it's joining a six million dollar National Science Foundation project with three other universities.
lines.t: On October fifth, the University of Alaska Fairbanks announced it's joining a six million dollar National Science Foundation project with three other universities.

lines.text: UAF's slice of that is about nine hundred thirteen thousand dollars.
lines.t: UAF's slice of that is about nine hundred thirteen thousand dollars.

lines.text: Microbes would recover rare earths from coal refuse and ash.
lines.t: Microbes would recover rare earths from coal refuse and ash.

lines.text: Rare earth atoms can cling to a cell's outer wall.
lines.t: Rare earth atoms can cling to a cell's outer wall.

lines.text: Two A I tools are planned. The first will predict how readily rare earths can be recovered.
lines.t: Two A I tools are planned. The first will predict how readily rare earths can be recovered.

lines.text: The second will adjust the bioreactor as conditions and available energy change, because living cells stall when power does.
lines.t: The second will adjust the bioreactor as conditions and available energy change, because living cells stall when power does.

lines.text: So the question is whether cells can keep working on Alaska's power.
lines.t: So the question is whether cells can keep working on Alaska's power.

lines.text: UAF professor Srijan Aggarwal says Alaska's remote energy challenges make energy use a central part of that question.
lines.t: UAF professor Srijan Aggarwal says Alaska's remote energy challenges make energy use a central part of that question.

lines.text: Power is the risk, so they'll build the plant in software first, a virtual pilot plant.
lines.t: Power is the risk, so they'll build the plant in software first, a virtual pilot plant.

lines.text: No results have been reported yet.
lines.t: No results have been reported yet.

lines.text: A smart controller can adapt to expensive power. It can't make power cheaper.
lines.t: A smart controller can adapt to expensive power. It can't make power cheaper.

lines.text: The obvious alternative is to ship the ash where power is cheap.
lines.t: The obvious alternative is to ship the ash where power is cheap.

lines.text: Lab and small pilot tests through August twenty thirty will weigh costs, energy, and environmental effects.
lines.t: Lab and small pilot tests through August twenty thirty will weigh costs, energy, and environmental effects.

lines.text: Energy isn't an afterthought here. It's the design brief.
lines.t: Energy isn't an afterthought here. It's the design brief.

lines.text: It becomes a win if the controller can keep microbes working on power that wobbles. If not, shipping wins.
lines.t: It becomes a win if the controller can keep microbes working on power that wobbles. If not, shipping wins.
